_about: RentCheck's deterministic scam checks. One source of truth: read by mcp_server/core.py and exported to the web app by update_data.py. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions that are valid in both Python and JavaScript. Warning signs follow An Garda Siochana's published advice on rental scams.

rules.title: Wants money before you've viewed it
rules.why: Gardaí's first rule: view the property and check the keys work before paying anything.

rules.title: Can't or won't show the property
rules.why: A common scam: the 'landlord' is abroad and asks for a deposit without a viewing.
rules.pattern: \b(working|living|currently|i am|i'm|we are|we're|based)\b[^.?!\n]{0,40}\b(abroad|overseas|out of the country|outside ireland|in (spain|france|germany|the uk|london|dubai|italy|nigeria|usa|canada|poland))\b|\b(can(?:'|no)?t|cannot|unable to|not possible to|no)\b[^.?!\n]{0,30}\b(view|viewing|viewings|show you|show the)\b|\bvirtual (tour|viewing)\b|\bvideo (tour|viewing) only\b

rules.title: Keys sent by post or courier
rules.why: Gardaí describe victims arriving to find the keys don't work or the 'landlord' has vanished.

rules.title: Untraceable payment method
rules.why: Gardaí recommend a traceable method such as a credit card. Money-transfer services, crypto and gift cards are hard to recover.

rules.title: Pressure to decide quickly
rules.why: Gardaí flag 'a sense of urgency' around transferring money as a warning sign.
rules.pattern: \b(lots of|many|several|other) (people|students|applicants|enquiries|interest)\b|\b(first come|first to pay|first person to|asap|as soon as possible|today only|urgent(ly)?|hurry|won't last|will go fast|confirm (fast|quickly|today))\b

rules.title: Moves you off the platform
rules.why: Scammers often avoid the listing site's messaging, where they can be reported.

rules.title: Asks for ID or bank documents early
rules.why: Sending passport or bank details before a viewing can lead to identity theft.
rules.pattern: \b(send|copy of|scan of|photo of)\b[^.?!\n]{0,30}\b(passport|id card|driving licen[cs]e|bank statement|pps)\b

rules.title: Says a booking site or 'agent' will handle the deposit
rules.why: Fake 'Airbnb' or 'Booking.com' payment emails are a known trick. Real long-term lets aren't paid this way.
